payload.title: OutputPiiScannerService.redact replaces overlapping detections one after another on the already-rewritten text, so when two patterns match the same digits (13 Luhn-valid digits are both a phone and a card number) the second replacement deletes characters that follow the PII
evidence: libs/backend-common/src/ai-safety/output-pii-scanner.service.ts:99 (the credit_card pattern matches the same digits when they pass Luhn; each pattern is scanned independently)

libs/backend-common/src/ai-safety/output-pii-scanner.service.ts:210-220 (detections are applied by descending startIndex to redactedText; a second range with the same start slices the rewritten string at the original endIndex)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-chat-bridge.service.ts:318 (AI channel replies are redacted again before they are stored)
payload.rule_violated: Redaction removes the PII and only the PII; the surrounding reply text is kept
payload.notes: 'Card 4222222222222 is on file.' redacts to 'Card [REDACTED] on file.': the card replacement slices the string the phone replacement already shortened, and the word after the number is lost. Found while building the streaming redactor, which needs redact to be well defined on overlapping ranges.
